# Saralak Search

> Saralak Search is a Thailand-based SEO, AEO, GEO and AI Search consultancy led by Saralak Kaewkum.

## Core Services
- [Discovery Audit](https://saralak-search.com/discovery-audit): SEO, GEO, AEO and Google Maps visibility audit.
- [SEO, GEO and AEO Services](https://saralak-search.com/services): Monthly visibility growth service.

## Founder
- [About Saralak Kaewkum](https://saralak-search.com/about): Founder profile, experience, expertise and contact details.
